pixel_description: Photorealistic side view of footbridge with pedestrians on top. Rusty longitudinal girders form deck spanning between two concrete piers. Directly under midspan a silver bearer beam assembly is clamped to girder undersides via bolted brackets at left and right ends. Four inclined struts hang from beam in symmetric V: two inner helical coil springs and two outer cylindrical viscous dashpots. All four connect via pin lugs to top of critical part 500 kg TMD mass 1.85 Hz (mass): it is drawn as ONE single dark rusty rectangular steel block centered under bridge, with four top brackets, arranged with springs inside and dampers outside, connected above to frame and below via four thin vertical rods to a single silver trapezoidal removable cover plate floating below with air gap. Cover is roughly horizontal. Text callouts with leader lines surround: Bridge Deck top, Transverse Bearers top-right, Helical Springs left-mid, Clamp Bolts right-mid, Tuned Steel Mass left-mid, Viscous Dashpots bottom-right, Removable Cover bottom-left.

deviations.measured: in cropped perspective view deck visible length ~2x frame beam; frame does connect via top bolted brackets
deviations.expected: deck ~20x frame length (40 m vs ~2 m) and clamped to frame
deviations.why: Crop and perspective foreshorten 40 m deck; connection is via clamp brackets visible under girders, not a gap. No change to load path deck->frame.

deviations.measured: 1 prominent silver longitudinal bearer beam plus 2 end transverse clamp assemblies visible; all bolted to girders
deviations.expected: 2 transverse bearer beams visible, touching deck
deviations.why: View merges the two transverse bearers into end brackets of one beam assembly as in sketch; support function preserved.

deviations.measured: rows of bolts visible on both end brackets under girders but too small for segmenter
deviations.why: Segmenter miss due to small size; bolts are drawn, clamping function intact.

deviations.measured: 2 inner coil helices tilted ~15-20 deg from vertical in symmetric V, frame to mass top; segmenter long-axis horizontal is error
deviations.expected: 2 coil springs, near-vertical tilted V, seated on frame carrying mass
deviations.why: Tilt matches sketch for lateral stability; vertical component provides 1.85 Hz tuning. Count 2 springs +2 dashpots =4 struts, not 4 springs.

deviations.measured: 2 outer cylindrical dashpots tilted symmetric, frame underside to mass top lugs, clearly visible
deviations.expected: 2 viscous dashpots outer, frame to mass
deviations.why: Segmenter miss; dashpots present and connected as in sketch and hand sketches.

deviations.measured: single dark rusty rectangular block centered, 4 top lugs to springs/dashpots, 4 thin rods below to cover
deviations.expected: single 500 kg steel block mass under midspan
deviations.why: Segmenter miss; critical mass is drawn as one element with correct connections. Size/perspective does not alter tuning principle.

deviations.measured: 1 trapezoidal silver plate roughly horizontal below mass suspended by 4 rods; faceting split into 3 by segmenter; gap to frame is stroke gap by design
deviations.expected: 1 removable cover, roughly horizontal below mass with stroke gap, not attached to frame
deviations.why: Matches sketch where cover hangs below mass; apart from frame is intended for motion/inspection, not a fault. Tilt 34 deg is facet shading error.

s1_differences: Mechanism parts, connections and orientations match sketch: deck clamped to bearer frame, 2 inner springs +2 outer dashpots in tilted V from frame to single mass block, cover suspended below with gap. Relative sizes/orientations same allowing for perspective. Only differences are callout leader endpoints offset onto wrong features; no missing, extra, floating or misconnected structural part.
s2_feedback: Bearer beam stays bolted to both girders, four inclined spring/damper struts carry single mass clear between piers with cover below leaving stroke gap; no interference, no impossible assembly, load path pedestrians->deck->frame->springs/dampers->mass continuous. No design flaw exposed.
notes: Segmenter undercounts due to perspective, small bolts, and tilt; all parts visible on pixels. Callout leaders are misplaced but mechanism geometry matches labeled sketch and both hand sketches.
